name: graphify
title: Graphify
description: Builds a knowledge graph of the codebase so agents read its structure before searching raw files.

config.label: Source paths
config.help: Directories, relative to the project root, that go into the graph.

config.label: Manifest files
config.help: Dependency manifests and lock files copied alongside the sources, such as package.json.

config.label: Refresh at session end
config.help: Rebuild the graph when a session ends and a source path changed structurally. Off by default because it adds time to every session end.

actions.label: Detect paths
actions.help: Propose source paths and manifests from the project's stack. Nothing is saved until you save the form.

actions.label: Rebuild graph
actions.help: Rebuild graphify-out/ now from the configured source paths.
